sensitivity.meaning: Revaluation of recorded outcomes and decision scores only; no alternative-policy operational claim

economicPrimaryMetric: Sum over all 50 planned trucks: observed provider fees + nonoverlapping valued time + non-energy distance + incremental lateness + initial/end battery inventory correction
gateRationale: CFIL04 PKW and completion gates retained. Truck mean horizon may increase by at most 1800s, matching the explicit economic time budget; punctuality and success cannot regress. Old CFIL04 verdicts are unchanged.
developmentFixtureSelection: Seed 693 chosen from deterministic vehicle input attributes for a smaller battery and high charging power, leaving positive deadline slack. Fixture parks 5/8 km with equal 750 kW connectors. Engineering witness only; excluded from primary evaluation.
budgetRationale: The 5-second durable-record limit is retained. Four concurrent synchronous writers exceeded it in V2 (6.3521842s and 7.8896627s). V3 permits two simulations at a time only after full-day qualification at that concurrency. An isolated full-day development run measured 0.2769004s. All monetary parameters and operational/utility gates remain unchanged.
retiredEvaluation: V1 was stopped before any completed evaluation because its 1s resource limit contradicted existing development evidence. V2 retained four complete runs but failed its 5s durable-record limit under four concurrent writers; its remaining runs were stopped. Both protocols and all results/partial sources are preserved. Seeds 701-710 are excluded from final V3 evaluation.
